# IO Moon Z80 I/O CPU (V1.3 set chip 05, IC5) -- code entry points.
#
# Format:  <hex address>  <label>  # evidence
#
# Everything above the first "# --- round" marker is the hand-derived seed:
# the three hardware entry points the Z80 itself defines, each read out of
# the ROM bytes rather than taken from any older material.  Everything below
# that marker is generated by tools/growz80.py and can be discarded and
# rediscovered with `sh asm/baseline-2026-09/tools/rebuild_z80.sh --from-seed`.

0000  reset_vector    # Z80 RESET fetches from 0000: NOP NOP / IM 1 / DI / JP 0400
0008  rst08_landing   # RST 08 lands here: NOP INC B NOP then the JP 0400 at 000B
0038  irq_vector      # IM 1 puts every maskable interrupt here: JP 0A42
0066  nmi_handler     # Z80 NMI vector; ends RETN (ED 45), confirming it is the NMI
